strategy_name: Read That Again: Understand, Share, Return
audience: People unfamiliar with the Quran; accessible and appropriate for ages 13-45. Select human situations, never infer an individual's religion.
ranking: No weighted engagement score. Pass eligibility first, then compare specific situation, insight, clarity, visual opportunity, and evidence. Preserve original scores only as historical hypotheses.

creative.boundary_note: Timing caps govern commentary only. Extend, contextualize, or select another complete passage when comprehension requires it.

tiktok.packaging: Conversational opening and concise specific caption; no watermark, engagement bait, or invented trend.

instagram.packaging: Readable cover, natural shareable insight; optional Trial Reel only when available, with trial distribution explicitly recorded.

youtube.packaging: Specific title and source; related long-form translation when supported and verified; no changes to long-form media or playlists.
